name: Goblin (E-Waste Collector)

sources.title: Team 10 Goblin E-Waste PitchDeck Plan
evidence: E-waste ambassadors collect smartphones for recycling firms
Social enterprise creates work for less-abled and less-fortunate people

sources.title: Team 10 Goblin E-Waste Implementation Plan
evidence: Proposed collection campaign around Jurong East
Refurbished devices and recovered materials as revenue sources

interpretation: The neighbourhood booth, inspection display and branching conveyor explain the concept; they are not a claim that the original project deployed automated sorting. No original application source or UI was available. Historical prices, forecasts and proposed partnerships are not displayed.
animation: 32-second deterministic loop. Intact device received, moves, stops for inspection, then follows refurbishment branch. Second damaged device follows the same inspection and takes material-recovery branch. Results activate on arrival. Reset after end transition; no reverse travel.
assets: New generated artwork. Existing MIT-licensed Microsoft Rocketbox mentor/learner meshes reused under public/landing/assets/lrnmate-people.
